metadata.short_desc: Drive a local Mio · 绘页 (comfy-comic-studio) by number and fetch the results
metadata.desc: Integrates a locally deployed Mio · 绘页 (comfy-comic-studio): /mio ls lists workflows / storyboards / presets with numbers, /mio use 1 2 3 assembles and starts a production task, /mio status shows progress and /mio get exports html/zip/pdf with the configured layout (or sends the frame images). Completion notifications and defaults are configured in a standalone control panel. Requires the bundled Mio patch.
